name: Tough Wolf Meat
summary: In Northshire and Coldridge, wolves prowl their valleys and provide meat for hungry locals. Tough Wolf Meat is coarse and stringy. People in Elwynn Forest eat it, and dwarven outfitters in Dun Morogh use it to stock their supplies.

sections.title: Frontier Rations
sections.body:
Wolves prowl near Northshire Valley and Dun Morogh. They threaten nearby settlements, yet their meat offers a hard-won source of food. Coarse, stringy and chewy, it is prized by resource-strapped frontiersmen.

Outside Northshire Abbey, Eagan Peltskinner hates the vicious beasts but cooks their meat into steaks. He trades basic supplies and gear to those who cull the packs.

faq.q: Where does Tough Wolf Meat come from?
aliases: how to get tough wolf meat
where to farm tough wolf meat
faq.answer: Young wolves and timber wolves in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest provide Tough Wolf Meat. Ragged wolves in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh provide it too.

faq.q: Who wants to collect this meat in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Eagan Peltskinner, outside Northshire Abbey, collects the meat. He hates the wolves, but cooks their meat into steaks and trades spare equipment to new recruits who bring him eight cuts.

faq.q: Is this meat useful outside of human lands?
faq.answer: Yes. Dwarven outfitters in frigid Dun Morogh accept meat from ragged wolves in Coldridge Valley to keep their supplies stocked.

faq.q: Is Tough Wolf Meat used in normal cooking recipes?
aliases: can you cook tough wolf meat
faq.answer: No. Local frontiersmen such as Eagan Peltskinner and Coldridge outfitters seek Tough Wolf Meat as a bounty. It is not an ingredient in standard camp cooking recipes.

angles.text: As a human recruit in Northshire Valley, you can gather wolf meat for Eagan Peltskinner outside the abbey. It is one of the earliest survival tasks beyond its quiet cloisters.
As a dwarf in Coldridge Valley, you can cull ragged timber wolves for meat to supply local outfitters before setting off across Dun Morogh.
